body:
Right now `stop_agencies` only keeps one row per stop. That works for picking a single agency to show, but some stops are served by more than one agency.

A few other places in the codebase need that full list, not just one, e.g. checking whether a stop is valid for a given agency, or listing all stops for an agency. Those currently do a live join every time. If this table stored one row per stop and agency instead of collapsing to the lowest one, it could back those lookups too.
